topic: Analyzing session data for facility reporting
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on analyzing device session concepts for a specific facility and date (January 1st). A query was reviewed showing that while the data is logically sound, the resulting traffic (8) and unique sessions (0) numbers are problematic from a client reporting perspective. The issue stems from having only local sessions with zero duration, and no real-world sessions.

It was noted that the model works on both real and local data, but the current output is misleading to the client. A potential solution involves creating a task/ticket for this discrepancy. Further discussion points included similar issues observed with dwell time metrics.
decisions: A task will be created to address the reporting discrepancy regarding traffic and unique sessions at the facility level.
action_items: [p1] will follow up with a decision or proposal on the issue, potentially involving dwell time, by the next day.
